import urllib.request as ur
import http.cookiejar
url = 'https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/3407'
cj = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener = ur.build_opener(ur.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), ur.HTTPRedirectHandler())
opener.addheaders = [
    ('User-Agent', 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'),
    ('Accept', 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8'),
    ('Accept-Language', 'en-US,en;q=0.9'),
    ('Referer', 'https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38'),
]
try:
    r = opener.open(url, timeout=20)
    print(f'final_url={r.url}')
    print(f'status={r.status}')
    print(f'ct={r.headers.get("Content-Type")}')
    print(f'cl={r.headers.get("Content-Length")}')
    body = r.read()
    print(f'body_len={len(body)}')
    print('--- first 3000 bytes ---')
    print(body[:3000].decode(errors='replace'))
    print('--- cookies ---')
    for c in cj:
        print(f'  {c.name}={c.value[:50]}... domain={c.domain}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'ERR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
